scope: Independent component-limit review. Corrections are proposed and have not been applied or bench tested.

blockers.title: IMU interface exceeds voltage limits

evidence.project: Published netlist U6.8=+3V3, U6.22=+3V3; design pulls SCL/SDA to +3V3.
evidence.document: TDK DS-000189 revision 1.6, manufacturer-authored PDF mirrored by SparkFun
evidence.limits: VDDIO 1.71–1.95 V operating, 2.5 V absolute maximum; specified digital input maximum VDDIO+0.5 V.

blockers.correction: Add a 1.8 V supply; move VDDIO and CS to it; retain VDD at 3.3 V; translate SCL, SDA and INT1. Detailed candidate circuit is in the report.
acceptance: Expected changed-pin list matches native netlist
No direct 3.3 V pull-up on a sensor-side signal
Both rails and signal levels measured through startup and shutdown
I2C identity read and interrupt operation pass

blockers.title: PWM buffer supply follows an unqualified actuator rail

evidence.project: U4.5 and U5.5 are on VSERVO, after source OR-ing diodes.
evidence.limits: Recommended VCC 4.5–5.5 V. Nominal 5–6 V BEC minus a diode does not guarantee this range.

blockers.correction: Supply U4/U5 and local bypass capacitors from regulated +5V_BUCK before D4; require that buck when PWM interfaces are populated, or qualify a separate regulated buffer supply.
acceptance: Netlist separates buffer supply from VSERVO
Buffer VCC stays 4.5–5.5 V across source/load cases
PWM remains low on startup, reset and brownout
No backfeed between BEC and regulated source

blockers.title: Input TVS cannot protect the present supply and current-sense devices

evidence.project: SMAJ33A clamps VIN_RAW; current-sense inputs and buck inputs share this supply through the shunt.
evidence.limits: SMAJ33A breakdown minimum 36.7 V and clamp 53.3 V at 7.5 A; INA180 common-mode absolute maximum 26 V; TPS54202 VIN 30 V absolute maximum; R1240 VIN 32 V absolute maximum.

blockers.correction: Select the battery/transient envelope explicitly, then coordinate the protection threshold and every exposed component. Retaining 6S requires a power-stage protection revision; a reduced-voltage prototype is a separate option, not an implemented decision.
acceptance: Battery and transient envelope documented
Worst-case clamp/cutoff plus overshoot stays below all protected pin limits
Fuse/TVS pulse-energy and temperature review
Reverse input and surge measurements with defined fixtures

blockers.title: Buck enable pin lacks a bounded voltage

evidence.project: R6=100 kΩ connects VIN_BUCK to U3 EN without a divider or documented clamp.
evidence.limits: EN absolute maximum 7 V; EN may float for enabled operation.

blockers.correction: Remove/DNP R6 and intentionally float EN for always-enabled operation, or implement the documented UVLO divider. Update schematic/BOM population consistency.
acceptance: No VIN pull-up remains on EN
EN state explicitly documented
Startup and EN voltage checked over the chosen battery range

blockers.title: Current-sense output is over its specified capacitive load

evidence.project: U8 OUT directly drives C37=100 nF and PA4 on ISENSE.
evidence.limits: Maximum capacitive load for no sustained oscillation is 1 nF.

blockers.correction: Add a proposed 1 kΩ output isolation resistor before the existing PA4/C37 node, or reduce direct capacitance to a qualified value. The RC proposal has a 100 μs time constant.
acceptance: Netlist places filter capacitor on ADC side of isolation resistor
Output stable on oscilloscope
ADC settles at selected sample rate
Current readout calibrated

blockers.title: 5 V buck output-current claim lacks ripple-current margin

evidence.project: L2=4.7 μH, 2 A output claim, 25.2 V maximum battery assumption. Calculations are captured in evidence.json.
evidence.limits: 390 kHz minimum switching frequency and 2.5 A minimum high-side current limit. Ideal nominal-L calculation requires 3.106 A peak at a 2 A load.

blockers.correction: Recalculate the inductor, saturation/thermal ratings and output capacitors for the final input and load envelope. Do not treat a 15 μH example value as a qualified footprint substitution.
acceptance: Worst-case L/frequency/tolerance calculation
Current-limit and inductor saturation margin
Capacitor effective capacitance verified
Load-step, ripple and thermal tests

nonblocker_dispositions.finding: Grounding AD0 selects 0x68 in I2C mode. The ERC bidirectional-to-power warning is separate from the real VDDIO fault. A documented I2C-specific input pin type can represent the selected mode.
Single-VCAP STM32F446RE uses 4.7 μF with ESR below 1 Ω. Existing pin30-to-ground topology is correct; effective capacitance and placement still need qualification.
